blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Israeli Ambassador Dana Kursh got a closer look at the legacy of former Naga City Mayor and Interior Secretary Jesse M. Robredo during her visit to the city on Monday, October 5. Kursh met with Naga Mayor Leni Robredo at City Hall before visiting the Museo ni Jesse Robredo, where she learned more about the former mayor’s life and approach to public service. Jesse Robredo served as Naga’s mayor for 19 years and became known for reforms that emphasized transparency, accountability and greater public participation in local government.
